title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：paragraph　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 paragraph 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the writer ① wrote the paragraph that no reader in the study would have noted, and he said the writing was the whole of the month. The ② paragraph, meaning the passage itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a paragraph, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ paragraph in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ paragraph at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A paragraph, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the writer said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the paragraph was the whole of the matter, meaning the point and not the passage. The ⑥ paragraph, meaning the point and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; paragraph, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a passage and a point. He said the point is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ paragraph had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ paragraph of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of noting; paragraph, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ paragraph I remember is the passage noted in the manuscript, which closed in 1981 and is still noted as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ paragraph, my mother said in 1983, is the only passage that improves by being noted; every paragraph, she said, is a point that has agreed to look like a passage. She said the point was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 段落（指书斋里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 段落（指那段段落本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：write the paragraph 写这一段段落
D. n. 段落（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 段落之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的段落之事）
F. n. 段落（指手稿里写到、被记下的那一段）
G. n. 段落、要点（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 要点（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wrote the paragraph that no reader in the study would have noted
The paragraph, meaning the passage itself and not the page
the paragraph at the far shelf
the paragraph was the whole of the matter
the paragraph had become a line in a manuscript
The paragraph of the whole thing
A paragraph, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: write the paragraph 意为“写这一段段落”，1974 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯记下的一段段落做了一遍。
paragraph 意为“段落”，指那段段落本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
paragraph 意为“段落”，指书斋里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
paragraph 意为“段落”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
paragraph 意为“段落、要点”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段要点就是那件事的全部。
paragraph 意为“要点”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段段落，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
paragraph 意为“段落”，指手稿里写到、被记下的那一段，到 1979 年这一段成了手稿里的一行。
paragraph 意为“段落之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的段落之事是一处书斋和三个月份的记下。
paragraph 意为“段落”，我记得的是手稿里记下过的那一段，1981 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一段。
paragraph 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，段落是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的段落。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年那位写作者写了书斋里没有一位读者肯记下的一段段落，他说这一遍才是那个月份的全部。（write the paragraph）
那段段落，指的是那段段落本身而不是薄薄的书页，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。（paragraph）
那处书斋里每一段段落旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。（paragraph）
最远那层书架那段段落，指的是他们留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（paragraph）
叔叔说这段要点就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那段段落。（paragraph）
1983 年母亲说，段落是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的段落。（paragraph）

The paragraph at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the paragraph was the whole of the matter, meaning the point and not the passage.
